 Brooklyn building collapse: At least 8 dead, 17 hurt
 At least eight people are dead after a building collapsed in Brooklyn, New York, while 17 others have been pulled from the rubble alive. Search and rescue crews continue working to reach anyone still trapped as officials warn the operation could take days. FOX 9's Chenue Her has the latest.
